sources.title: Recap: Tennessee falls to Texas 20-17
sources.description: The Tennessee Volunteers made things close late, but it wasn’t enough, as they fell to the No. 1 Texas Longhorns 20-17 on Saturday afternoon at Neyland Stadium. Tennessee rallied in the final minutes and got a Hail Mary into the end zone, but it fell incomplete. It was a brutal day on the offensive side […]
